correctness.rationale: In the free intersection lattice write the fiber class as \(F=mA\). Fiber self-intersection gives \(A^2=0\). The adapted almost-complex structure gives \(\langle c_1,F\rangle=2-2g\), while \(c_1\) is characteristic because \(c_1\bmod2=w_2\) and the Wu formula gives \(\langle c_1,A\rangle\equiv A^2\pmod2\). Thus \(\langle c_1,A\rangle\) is even and \(m\mid(g-1)\). Corollary 8 of arXiv:2610.01776v1 then yields the asserted positive multisection degrees. Torsion is harmless because the calculation is in \(H_2/\operatorname{Tor}\) and cohomology pairings vanish on torsion.
